name: One Commendation Signet
label: Quest
description: One Commendation Signet: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: For those adventurers who have but a single commendation signet, I'll exchange it for a small amount of recognition with Thunder Bluff.

Please bear in mind that it is better to hand over a stack of ten signets at once; your efforts will receive greater recognition in doing so. We offer a single signet exchange as a service for those who don't have enough for a full stack of ten.
With that being said, I stand ready to assist you if you still wish to hand in a single signet.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very well - your deeds have been entered into the records, and you are duly recognized for your efforts. Keep up the good work, adventurer.
If you have any more signets to hand in, then I am able to assist you further in that regard.
